name: Crate With Holes
summary: In Ratchet, Mebok Mizzyrix prepares a crate for a Snufflenose Gopher.

sections.title: A Sniffer in a Box
sections.body: Mebok Mizzyrix sends trained Snufflenose Gophers to find Blueleaf Tubers in Razorfen Kraul. The gophers cannot follow an adventurer across the Barrens on foot, so Mebok places each one in a wooden crate with air holes. Inside the quilboar stronghold, the crate is opened and the gopher follows its keen nose toward the buried tubers.

faq.q: What is inside the Crate With Holes?
faq.answer: A living Snufflenose Gopher trained by Mebok Mizzyrix rides inside. Holes in the crate let it breathe as it travels across the Barrens.

faq.q: Where do I get the Crate With Holes?
aliases: where to find crate with holes
faq.answer: You can take a crate from the pile beside Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet, the port town on the Barrens' eastern coast.

faq.q: How does the crate work inside Razorfen Kraul?
aliases: how to use crate with holes
faq.answer: Open the crate inside Razorfen Kraul to release the Snufflenose Gopher. Direct it with a Snufflenose Command Stick, and it will use its nose to find Blueleaf Tubers buried underground.

faq.q: Why are Blueleaf Tubers so hard to find without the gopher?
faq.answer: Blueleaf Tubers grow deep underground among Razorfen Kraul's roots, beyond ordinary sight. Snufflenose Gophers can smell them from fifty paces away.
